## What kind of change

- [ ] Bug fix (no API change)
- [ ] New feature (additive — no API change to existing callers)
- [ ] Refactor (no functional change)
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Build / CI / packaging
- [ ] Breaking change to a public API (C ABI, Python, Rust, Go or TypeScript):
      add the `breaking-change` label; it ships only in a new major version
